summary: Stockholm Nordtech Group AB is a private equity firm specializing in growth capital. The firm focuses on acquiring and developing niche software companies and supporting their long-term growth and also focuses on small and medium-sized SaaS companies, technology, B2B software companies, vertical markets, business process management, ecommerce, education, financial management, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, manufacturing, requirements management, retail and supplier integration solutions. The firm typically invests in the Nordic region. The firm takes a long-term approach and invests in companies with recurring revenues, established market positions and a turnover of SEK 15 million ($1.59 million) and SEK100 million ($10.57 million). Stockholm Nordtech Group AB was founded in 2021 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
